xBRIEFInfo.description: Consumer/operator docs for running Directive under OpenClaw persistent-memory agents.

narratives.Description: Consumer/operator docs for running Directive under OpenClaw persistent-memory agents. content/platforms today is hardware-oriented; agent-host OpenClaw guidance belongs under interfaces or docs with skill pointers only.
narratives.Overview: Epic #2874 P1 docs. Discoverable path; does not invent skill contracts.
narratives.UserStory: As an OpenClaw operator, I want discoverable Directive host docs, so that first-session babysit and spawn expectations are clear.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Step 1: Add content/docs or content/interfaces agent-host OpenClaw markdown with Control UI and identity guidance. Step 2: Cross-link from QUICK-START.md or docs index. Step 3: Link skills without inventing contracts. Step 4: CHANGELOG #2877. Verification: links resolve; task check:merge. Touch concrete source files listed in plan.metadata.swarm.file_scope. Verification evidence: run targeted unit tests or verify gates and capture pass evidence in the PR.
narratives.Traces: Acceptance criteria map to #2877; missing_traces_justification until implementation maps lines.

narrative.Acceptance: Given shipped docs tree, when operator searches for OpenClaw, then a short agent-host doc is findable and linked from an index or QUICK-START.
Given the doc, when read by first-session operator, then babysit routes to sessions_spawn Approach 1 expectation is stated with pointers to skill text.
Given the doc, when compared to skills, then it links to shipped skill contracts rather than inventing new gate semantics.
